text:
Mira: kicking off today's staged rollout for embeddings-svc v2.0 — micro-wedge plan: 1% -> 10% -> 30%. Who's owning the deploy and smoke?
Sam: I can own the deploy window 15:00-16:30 PT. will coordinate with infra.
Raj: I'll own the smoke checks and run the eval set after each step. will post pass/fail.
Kelly: tagging the rollback owner — @Sam make sure the previous docker tag is pinned and health-check is exposed. :thumbsup:
Sam: yup previous tag is `emb-v1.9.8-20260218`. rollback is `deploy rollback emb-service emb-v1.9.8-20260218`.
Ava: I'll monitor latency SLOs and error budget in the console, will flag any +5% latency or >0.5% 5xxs.
DevOps Bot: deploy scheduled by Sam at 2026-02-12T22:00:00Z (job #2248).
Mira: cohort selection: start with EU-west 1% + internal beta group (flagged users). then global 10% excluding tiered enterprise. final 30% includes low-risk US regions. any objections?
Kelly: fine. confirm feature-flag rollout will use `ff:emb_v2_rollout` with user segments `internal,beta,euw-1,low-risk`
Raj: smoke checklist (short):
```
- inference smoke: send 50 requests over 30s
- embedding diffs: run sample 1k prompt set, threshold mean-cosine >= 0.98
- kv-cache memory check: < 80% usage
- logs: no surge of OOM or io errors
```
Sam: I'll run step 1 -> wait for Raj OK -> step 2 -> wait -> step 3. timing estimate: 10m per step plus 15m observation.
Mira: communication plan: post status in #eng-releases at each step and update rollout doc link: https://redwood-internal/rollouts/embeddings-v2 (short updates only).
Ava: added a dashboard watch and alert: if p50 latency increases by +100ms or error rate >0.2% within 10m, I'll ping #oncall and this thread.
Kelly: preflight, remember to disable autoscale burst for embeddings-svc during the 30% step to avoid capacity noise.
Sam: done, autoscale burst disabled in staging and will flip for prod at step 3 window.
Raj: FYI I'll produce a quick log-grep command and perf snapshot after each step:
```
# per step snapshot
kubectl logs -l app=embeddings-svc --since=10m | grep -E "error|OOM|timeout" | head -n 50
kubectl top pods -l app=embeddings-svc
```
Mira: ok owners set. @Sam you have rollback readiness? confirm script, previous image exists, and DB migrations are safe.
Sam: confirm all three. script tested in staging. previous image already in prod registry. no DB migrations in this deploy.
Kelly: tagging infra: please ensure node replacement policy is relaxed for the 2hr window (no autoscaler replacement) — @DevOps Bot can you annotate the job?
DevOps Bot: annotation added: `no-node-replace` for job #2248.
Ava: I'll run a smoke run after step 2 that includes a sample A/B of 1000 requests against v1 and v2 to check quality drift.
Mira: perfect. let's reconvene in this thread with timestamps for each step. good luck and ping if anything odd. :rocket:
